verdict_reason: Fields match the v0.4.0 tradeParty def, but the record (with eleven siblings) is an unchanged copy of its gbnagv3 twin, raised once here as a duplication finding.

todos.issue: Twelve new gbnagv4 records are byte-for-byte copies of their gbnagv3 twins apart from the package line (diff -r gbnagv3 gbnagv4 shows only line 1 differing): PimsLogisticsTransportMeans, PimsLogisticsTransportMovement, PimsProductUnitQuantity, PimsReferencedDocument, PimsSpecifiedConsignment, PimsTradeAddress, PimsTradeCountry, PimsTradeCountrySubDivision, PimsTradeLineItem, PimsTradeParty, PimsTradeProductInstance, PimsTransportEvent. The only v0.3.0 to v0.4.0 schema change is the removal of exchangedDocument.issuer (PimsExchangedDocument). docs/notification-pipeline.md:17 records per-version copies as deliberate (and pom.xml sonar.cpd.exclusions hides them), but the house rule is one rule, one owner, and an earlier decision is not a reason to keep a copy.
todos.fix: Must: each PIMS record shape that is identical across v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 has one definition, or the workspace rules/docs explicitly exempt frozen per-version PIMS packages from the one-owner rule so this is not re-raised. One way: have gbnagv4 define only PimsExchangedDocument, PimsGbnAgData and the records that reach issuer, and import the unchanged gbnagv3 records; or, if per-version insulation is kept, add the exemption to .claude/rules/code-quality.md alongside the existing feature-folder controller exemption.
